summary: {person} wants to know whether losing a bus segment also costs a resident paratransit coverage.
realLife: Milwaukee Transit Plus staff told their advisory council the in-county service area would remain intact while they studied proposed fixed-route eliminations.
gates: A resident asks about a pickup where a fixed route may be shortened.
weights: A pickup near a shortened route makes a coverage question more likely.
inGame: needs: fixed-route proposal, local paratransit boundary and pickup location.

turns.what: Staff confirm coverage and check separate booking requirements.
turns.pulledBy: The pickup remains in the adopted service area.

turns.what: Staff verify the responsible provider before promising service.
turns.pulledBy: The pickup lies beyond the county boundary.
turns.writesBack: Keep the cross-boundary referral on the case.
